content: The above loss function aligns the trainable variables in the student space. Alternatively, we can project trainable variables in $\theta _{s}$ to the same shape as in $\theta _{t}$. This way, the loss function in Equation DISPLAY_FORM8, ($\uparrow $ denotes up projection) can compare the trainable variables in the teacher space.
